# dsh-account-glance
A compact DeepSeek account panel in the sidebar footer, directly above the account avatar. One card
shows the account balance, the current off-peak/peak billing window with a countdown to the next swi
tch, and the rate of both windows.
English | 中文
## Features
- **Balance** — the signed-in DeepSeek account balance (top-up plus bonus wallets). Refreshed once a
minute, on window focus, and when the page becomes visible again. Shows a short reason on failure a

nd keeps the last good value when a refresh fails.
- **Billing window** — peak or off-peak, computed
locally in Beijing time without any network request: peak on workdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00,
off-peak at half the peak rate at all other times (weekends included). A live countdown shows the ti

me to the next switch.
- **Rate** — off-peak 50% / peak full price, with the active one highlighted.

- **Locale** — zh/en copy, following the client locale.
- Zero runtime dependencies; the host half
is an empty module, all behaviour lives in the web client and uses the shipped `remote.account` name
empty module, all behaviour lives in the web client and uses the shipped `remote.account` namespace.
## Install
Settings → Plugins → Install:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x and a signed-in DeepSeek account. Nothing is written back or sent an
ywhere except reading the account state and balance through the built-in Remote API.
## How it works
`index.js` is the host half (no-op). `client.js` registers a `sidebar.footer.action` slot via the mo
dule loader, injects `slots`, `locale`, `remote` and `remote.account`, and calls `remote.account.get
State()` / `getBalance(metadata)`. The billing schedule is pure local arithmetic on Beijing wall-clo
ck time, so the card works even when the balance endpoint is unavailable.

## 中文
侧栏左下角头像上方的紧凑账户卡片：显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、当前闲时/忙时计费时段及切换倒计时、以及两种时段的费率。余额每 60 秒自动刷新，窗口重新可见或获得焦点时也会刷新；闲忙时段按北京时
间本地计算，不发起网络请求。支持中英文，无运行时依赖。
